author: mikes703
quote: Worst part is the constant modern workplace nonsense dropped into a fantasy setting—pronoun lectures, non-binary characters lecturing everyone, push-up apologies for misgendering, and the same forced messaging a lot of people already have to sit through at their jobs. Most players don’t want that in their games. 99% of people don’t agree with it and don’t like it being shoved in.

author: mikes703
quote: Combat is stiff. Stealth is readable and dull. Enemy AI still loses you around a corner. The RPG layer — gear scores, engraving, skill trees — is the same system Odyssey and Valhalla already wore out. Nothing here justifies another pass.

author: mikes703
quote: Great game.  When times of games like Wolverine and Gears of war exist we have a good game here.  Even though the stars wars franchise has been highly sus in its own right.  A nice almost faithful sequel to the other pod racer games.

author: mikes703
quote: Classic Gears toys are gone. No meat shield. No sticky grenades. No chainsaw duels. No private matches. What replaced them is a jump-to-cover gimmick and a campaign that keeps shoving Mags Carter into the frame while the two characters on the box wait their turn. Bosses are worse than the regular fights. Enemy AI is a coin flip between “stands in the open” and “clips into geometry.” Framerate dips show up exactly when the screen is full of the only thing the game knows how to do.

author: mikes703
quote: This is THE worse game that went gold on a physical copy.  The game is unfinished and lacks the polish you would expect from a standard physical game.

author: mikes703
quote: The Aberrant shapeshifts — sword, scythe, hammer, whip, drill — and the combos slap. Powers stack. Bosses are spectacles. Side missions are actually weird in the Remedy way, not checklist junk.Dylan works. Awkward, damaged, trying. The story hits harder than it has any right to.Same studio DNA: brutalist beauty, cosmic bureaucracy, a score that crawls under your skin. Bigger scale. Better action. Still completely itself.

author: mikes703
quote: When I found the alien isolation devs did most of this game I was excited.  The CRTV is genius. A chunky little handheld TV that hisses, scans, and shows you what’s waiting through walls. It’s not a gimmick. It’s your lifeline, your puzzle tool, and your worst friend.Stealth is tense. Combat is ugly and desperate when you have to fight. Puzzles actually make you think. The story — guilt, corporate rot, a town that won’t stay buried — lands like a punch.Pilotpriest’s score slaps. The Otherworld still slaps. Multiple endings give you a reason to go back.Best new Silent Hill since the classics. Play it.

author: mikes703
quote: Played about 35 hours. The world looks great and the sword fights still feel good when they click, but this is basically Ghost of Tsushima with a new coat of paint and a different lead.Atsu’s revenge plot is the same “hunt the six guys who killed my family” loop you already know. Once you take down the first couple targets the structure repeats: ride to a new region, clear the same kinds of camps, do the same kinds of side activities, fight another named guy. The story never really surprises you.

author: mikes703
quote: Best game of the year for me.  GTA6 is looking like an interactive movie and not a real game.  Zelda is a remake so I have to give more credit for a new IP Crimson Desert. This is better than RE9, Forza, 007, and onimusha.

author: mikes703
quote: Insomniac keeps saying crashes hit a small percentage. That percentage was me: stuck in geometry, photo mode broken, scent trails so loud they might as well be a bug, hotfix after hotfix through early October. Combat already repeats. When the claws clip through the floor and the objective never updates, there is nothing left. Spider-Man 2 did not do this. This one did.
